owner-open: (async()=>{const click=a=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(e=>e.getAttribute('aria-label')===a&&e.getBoundingClientRect().height);if(!b)throw Error(a);b.click()};click('Close');click('Approve privacy');await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,700));click('Open profile editor');return 'Profile opened'})()
upload-photo: (async()=>{const root=document.querySelector('app-profile-onboarding-popup');const lang=[...root.querySelectorAll('button')].find(e=>e.innerText.includes('English')&&e.innerText.includes('expand_more'));lang?.click();root.querySelector('button[aria-label="Next step"]').click();const response=await fetch('/media/public?key=images%2Fdemo-profiles%2F650000000000000000000061%2Fphoto-01%2Fsmall.webp');if(!response.ok)throw Error('Demo photo unavailable');const data=new DataTransfer();data.items.add(new File([await response.blob()],'affiliate-qa.webp',{type:'image/webp'}));const input=root.querySelector('input[type="file"]');input.files=data.files;input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,450));return document.body.innerText.slice(-2200)})()
photos-finish: (async()=>{const root=document.querySelector('app-profile-onboarding-popup');const blob=await fetch('/media/public?key=images%2Fdemo-profiles%2F650000000000000000000061%2Fphoto-01%2Fsmall.webp').then(r=>r.blob());for(const slot of [1,2]){const input=root.querySelectorAll('input[type="file"]')[slot];const dt=new DataTransfer();dt.items.add(new File([blob],'qa-'+slot+'.webp',{type:'image/webp'}));input.files=dt.files;input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1700));}return [...root.querySelectorAll('button')].slice(-6).map(b=>({a:b.getAttribute('aria-label'),disabled:b.disabled}))})()
review: (async()=>{const root=document.querySelector('app-profile-onboarding-popup');for(let i=0;i<2;i++){const b=root.querySelector('button[aria-label="Next step"]');if(!b||b.disabled)throw Error('Next step unavailable');b.click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));}return [...root.querySelectorAll('button')].slice(-6).map(b=>({a:b.getAttribute('aria-label'),disabled:b.disabled}))})()
confirm-generate: (async()=>{[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(e=>e.innerText.trim()==='Generate').click();for(let i=0;i<30;i++){await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200));const secret=[...document.querySelectorAll('app-integration-settings-popup .integration-token-secret code')].map(e=>e.innerText).find(s=>s.startsWith('msc_'));if(secret)return {secret,clientId:crypto.randomUUID()};}throw Error('Secret not revealed')})()
reopen-after-reload: (async()=>{const click=a=>{const b=document.querySelector('button[aria-label="'+a+'"]');if(!b)throw Error(a);b.click()};click('Open profile editor');for(let i=0;i<30;i++){await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,150));if(document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Open affiliate settings"]'))break;}click('Open affiliate settings');await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,650));return {badges:[...document.querySelectorAll('app-integration-settings-popup .integration-count-badge')].map(e=>e.innerText),settingsRequests:performance.getEntriesByType('resource').filter(e=>e.name.includes('/integrations/settings')).length}})()
